§ 01 · The Program

A complete
portfolio.

From foundational B1 trade vocabulary to advanced C1 strategy and compliance discourse, every module is anchored in real-world import and export scenarios — from customs clearance to freight forwarding, from trade finance to cross-border disputes. Built for use inside logistics firms, customs brokerages, trading companies, and global sourcing teams.

01

Industry-anchored

Every question reflects real terminology from customs clearance, freight forwarding, and international trade finance in 2026.

02

GenAI customs processing, blockchain trade documents, and predictive shipping analytics run throughout the program — reflecting today's global trade industry.
